Title: Checkout with a single product as a new user
Description: A guest adds one in-stock product, creates an account, and completes checkout with the published test card.
Precondition: The browser is signed out and the cart is empty. At least one active product has stock of 1 or more. The email and username used in this run do not already exist.
Step Action: Open the storefront home page.
Expected Results: The home page loads. Browse Products and Sign In are visible. The cart does not show a count.
notes: Password must be at least 8 characters and include one uppercase letter and one number. Signup returns to the catalog, not checkout, so the cart must still be there. Use a new email and username on every run. Test card is 4242 4242 4242 4242. Shipping is free.

Step Action: Click Browse Products.
Expected Results: The Product Catalog opens and lists one or more products.

Step Action: Open the first product that is not Out of Stock. Record its name and price as Product A.
Expected Results: The product page shows Product A's name, price, and an enabled Add to Cart button. The stock badge shows a count greater than zero.

Step Action: Click Add to Cart.
Expected Results: The button changes to In Cart (1). The cart badge shows 1.

Step Action: Click View Cart.
Expected Results: Shopping Cart shows only Product A with quantity 1. Shipping is Free. Subtotal and total both equal Product A's price.

Step Action: Click Proceed to Checkout.
Expected Results: The guest is taken to the login page. The checkout form is not shown.

Step Action: Click Sign Up.
Expected Results: The Create an Account page opens.

Step Action: Enter a unique email, phone 5550101001, a unique username, password NewUser1!, and the same password in Confirm Password. Click Create Account.
Expected Results: The account is created. The catalog opens and the navbar shows the new username. The cart badge still shows 1.

Step Action: Open the cart and click Proceed to Checkout.
Expected Results: Checkout opens. The order summary lists only Product A, quantity 1, shipping Free, and the same total as the cart.

Step Action: Enter first name Ada, last name Lovelace, and address 123 Test Street, Austin, TX 78701. Enter card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVV 123, and name on card Ada Lovelace. Click Place Order.
Expected Results: The button shows Processing, then Order Confirmed opens. A new order number is shown with status Pending, shipping name Ada Lovelace, the entered address, and one line for Product A. The total matches the cart. The card number and CVV are not displayed.

Step Action: Open My Orders from the username in the navbar.
Expected Results: The cart badge is cleared. My Orders lists the new order with status Pending, one item, and the same total.

Title: Login as an existing user and complete checkout
Description: An existing customer signs in, buys one in-stock product, and sees the order in My Orders with stock reduced by one.
Precondition: The browser is signed out and the cart is empty. standard_user can sign in with password standard123. At least one active product has stock of 1 or more.
Step Action: Open the login page.
Expected Results: Welcome Back is shown with Username or Email, Password, and Sign In.
notes: Record Product B's stock before adding it so the final stock check is exact. Do not use a product another tester is updating. Test card is 4242 4242 4242 4242.

Step Action: Enter username standard_user and password standard123. Click Sign In.
Expected Results: The Product Catalog opens. The navbar shows standard_user and does not show Sign In.

Step Action: Open an in-stock product. Record its name, price, and stock count as Product B. Click Add to Cart.
Expected Results: The button changes to In Cart (1). The cart badge shows 1.

Step Action: Open the cart.
Expected Results: The cart contains only Product B with quantity 1. Shipping is Free. The total equals Product B's price.

Step Action: Click Proceed to Checkout.
Expected Results: Checkout opens immediately. The shopper is not sent back to login.

Step Action: Enter first name Jordan, last name Lee, and address 500 Market Street, Seattle, WA 98101. Enter card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVV 123, and name on card Jordan Lee. Click Place Order.
Expected Results: Order Confirmed opens for a new order. Status is Pending. Shipping shows Jordan Lee and the entered address. The only item is Product B and the total matches the cart. The card number and CVV are not displayed.

Step Action: Click the username in the navbar.
Expected Results: My Orders opens with Welcome back, standard_user. The new order is listed with status Pending and the same total.

Step Action: Open that order, then return to Product B's product page.
Expected Results: The order detail repeats the order number, Pending status, item, and total. Product B's stock is one less than the count recorded before checkout.

Title: Login as an existing user and check order status
Description: A signed-in customer opens My Orders and confirms the list status matches the order detail.
Precondition: standard_user has at least one order. If not, run TC-E2E-002 first and record that order number. The browser is signed out.
Step Action: Open the login page and sign in as standard_user with password standard123.
Expected Results: The catalog opens and the navbar shows standard_user.
notes: Status text is Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, or Cancelled. Compare the list badge with the detail badge for the same order number.

Step Action: Click the username in the navbar.
Expected Results: My Orders opens. The heading is My Orders and the page says Welcome back, standard_user.

Step Action: Find the order recorded in the precondition.
Expected Results: The row shows the order number, a status badge, the order date, the item count, and the total.

Step Action: Click that order.
Expected Results: The order detail shows the same order number and the same status. Shipping name, address, items, and total are shown.

Step Action: Go back to My Orders.
Expected Results: The order is still listed with the same status and total shown on the detail page.

Step Action: Click Logout, then open /orders directly.
Expected Results: The home page is shown and Sign In is visible. Opening /orders redirects to the login page and does not show the order list.

Title: Login as admin and add a new product
Description: An admin creates an active product and a guest can see it in the catalog with the price and stock that were entered.
Precondition: The browser is signed out. The admin password is $Admin followed by today's date as DDMMYYYY. For 18 October 2026 the password is $Admin18102026.
Step Action: Open the login page. Enter username admin_user and the calculated admin password. Click Sign In.
Expected Results: The catalog opens. The navbar shows Admin and admin_user.
notes: Product names must be unique. A duplicate name is rejected. New products are saved as active, so the Active toggle is not on the create form. Leave this product in place if TC-E2E-009 will purchase it. Otherwise edit it afterward and clear Product is active.

Step Action: Click Admin.
Expected Results: The Admin Dashboard opens on Overview and shows Products, Orders, Users, and Pending counts.

Step Action: Open the Products tab.
Expected Results: The inventory table is shown and Add Product is available.

Step Action: Click Add Product.
Expected Results: The Add New Product modal opens with Name, Description, Price, Stock, and image upload.

Step Action: Enter a unique name such as E2E Test Lamp plus the run time, description Desk lamp created by the end-to-end suite, price 19.99, and stock 5. Click Create Product.
Expected Results: The modal closes. The new product appears in the inventory with price $19.99, stock 5, and Active status.

Step Action: Click Logout. As a guest, open the Product Catalog and find the new product.
Expected Results: The product is listed at $19.99.

Step Action: Open the new product page.
Expected Results: Add to Cart is enabled. The badge says 5 in stock. The image shows Only 5 left.

Title: Login as admin and update an existing order status
Description: An admin changes an existing order from Pending to Processing and then to Shipped, and the new status remains after refresh.
Precondition: A known order is Pending. Record its order number and customer. The admin can sign in with the current $AdminDDMMYYYY password. The browser is signed out.
Step Action: Sign in as admin_user with the calculated admin password.
Expected Results: The catalog opens and the Admin link is visible.
notes: Use an order created by TC-E2E-001 or TC-E2E-002. Status options are Pending, Processing, Shipped, Delivered, and Cancelled. Leave the order as Shipped if TC-E2E-008 will confirm it as the customer.

Step Action: Open Admin and select the Orders tab.
Expected Results: Order History lists Order, Customer, Location, Date, Total, and Status. The target order is present with Pending selected.

Step Action: Change that order's status from Pending to Processing.
Expected Results: Processing stays selected and no error is shown.

Step Action: Refresh the page and open the Orders tab again.
Expected Results: The same order still shows Processing.

Step Action: Change the status to Shipped, refresh, and open the Orders tab again.
Expected Results: The same order still shows Shipped. The customer, date, and total are unchanged.

Title: Login as admin and update inventory quantity
Description: An admin changes a product's stock, and the new quantity remains after refresh and is visible to a shopper.
Precondition: The browser is signed out. Choose an active product that no other test is buying and record its current stock as S. The admin can sign in with the current $AdminDDMMYYYY password.
Step Action: Sign in as admin_user and open Admin, then the Products tab.
Expected Results: The inventory table shows the chosen product with stock S.
notes: Stock saves when the field loses focus, not on each keystroke. Set the value to 4 so the low-stock alert is predictable. Restore stock to S at the end so the catalog is not left low.

Step Action: Replace that product's stock with 4 and click outside the field.
Expected Results: The field shows 4 and no error is shown.

Step Action: Refresh the page and open the Products tab again.
Expected Results: The product stock is still 4.

Step Action: Open the Overview tab.
Expected Results: Low Stock Alert lists the product with a badge of 4 left.

Step Action: Sign out and open that product as a guest.
Expected Results: The product badge says 4 in stock and the image shows Only 4 left. Add to Cart is enabled.

Step Action: Sign in as admin_user, open Products, set the stock back to S, and click outside the field. Refresh the Products tab.
Expected Results: The product stock is S again.

Title: Invalid card does not place an order
Description: A signed-in customer submits checkout with a card that fails the Luhn check. No order is created, the cart remains, and stock does not change.
Precondition: standard_user is signed in. The cart contains exactly one in-stock product. Record that product's stock as N and the current number of orders for standard_user.
Step Action: Open the cart and click Proceed to Checkout.
Expected Results: Checkout opens with the single cart item, shipping Free, and the matching total.
notes: 4242 4242 4242 4241 fails the Luhn check. The valid test card is 4242 4242 4242 4242 and must not be used in this case.

Step Action: Enter first name Jordan, last name Lee, and address 500 Market Street, Seattle, WA 98101.
Expected Results: The shipping fields keep the entered values.

Step Action: Enter card 4242 4242 4242 4241, expiry 12/30, CVV 123, and name on card Jordan Lee. Click Place Order.
Expected Results: Checkout stays open. An alert says Invalid card number. Please check and try again. The order summary still shows the same item.

Step Action: Open My Orders.
Expected Results: No new order appears. The order count matches the count recorded in the precondition.

Step Action: Open the product page for the cart item.
Expected Results: Stock is still N.

Step Action: Open the cart.
Expected Results: The same item is still in the cart with the same quantity and total.

Title: Customer sees an order status changed by an admin
Description: A customer confirms an order is Pending, an admin marks it Delivered, and the customer sees Delivered after signing in again.
Precondition: standard_user has a Pending order. Record its order number and total. Both standard_user and admin_user can sign in. The browser is signed out.
Step Action: Sign in as standard_user and open My Orders.
Expected Results: The recorded order is listed with status Pending and the recorded total.
notes: Run after TC-E2E-002, or after returning the TC-E2E-005 order to Pending. Delivered is the final status checked by the customer.

Step Action: Sign out.
Expected Results: The home page is shown and the username is no longer in the navbar.

Step Action: Sign in as admin_user, open Admin, then the Orders tab, and select Delivered for the recorded order.
Expected Results: Delivered stays selected for that order. The customer name and total do not change.

Step Action: Refresh and open the Orders tab again, then sign out.
Expected Results: The order still shows Delivered. After sign-out, the home page is shown.

Step Action: Sign in as standard_user and open My Orders.
Expected Results: The same order now shows Delivered. The total is unchanged.

Step Action: Open the order.
Expected Results: The detail page shows Delivered, the original items, the original total, and the original shipping details.

Title: Buy a product created by an admin and confirm stock decreases
Description: A customer purchases the product created in the admin add-product case, and both the storefront and inventory show the reduced stock.
Precondition: TC-E2E-004 created E2E Test Lamp, or an equivalent uniquely named product, with price $19.99 and stock 5. standard_user is signed out and the cart is empty.
Step Action: Sign in as standard_user with password standard123.
Expected Results: The catalog opens and the navbar shows standard_user.
notes: If the product name differs from E2E Test Lamp, use the name created in TC-E2E-004. Expected stock after one purchase is 4.

Step Action: Open the admin-created product.
Expected Results: The price is $19.99. The badge says 5 in stock and the image shows Only 5 left.

Step Action: Click Add to Cart, open the cart, and click Proceed to Checkout.
Expected Results: The cart and checkout summary show only that product, quantity 1, shipping Free, and total $19.99.

Step Action: Enter first name Jordan, last name Lee, and address 500 Market Street, Seattle, WA 98101. Enter card 4242 4242 4242 4242, expiry 12/30, CVV 123, and name on card Jordan Lee. Click Place Order.
Expected Results: Order Confirmed opens with status Pending, one item, and total $19.99. The card number and CVV are not displayed.

Step Action: Open the same product page again.
Expected Results: The badge says 4 in stock and the image shows Only 4 left.

Step Action: Sign out, sign in as admin_user, and open Admin, then Products. Find the product.
Expected Results: The inventory stock for that product is 4 and its status is still Active.

Title: Signed-out shopper cannot open orders and a returning customer can
Description: After sign-out, direct links to orders and admin are blocked. Signing back in returns the customer to the requested order with the same status.
Precondition: standard_user is signed in on My Orders and has at least one order. Record that order number, status, and total.
Step Action: On My Orders, confirm the recorded order, its status, and its total.
Expected Results: The order row matches the recorded number, status, and total.
notes: A signed-out visit to /admin goes to login. A signed-in customer who is not an admin is returned to the home page instead of the dashboard.

Step Action: Click Logout.
Expected Results: The home page opens. The navbar shows Sign In and does not show the username or Admin.

Step Action: Open /orders directly.
Expected Results: The login page opens. The order list is not shown.

Step Action: Open /orders/<recorded order number> directly.
Expected Results: The login page opens. The order detail is not shown.

Step Action: Open /admin directly.
Expected Results: The login page opens. The Admin Dashboard is not shown.

Step Action: Sign in as standard_user with password standard123.
Expected Results: The app returns to the order that was requested before login. The order number, status, items, and total match the values recorded in the first step.

Step Action: Open /admin.
Expected Results: The Admin Dashboard is not shown. The shopper is returned to the home page.

Step Action: Open My Orders from the username.
Expected Results: The recorded order is still listed with the same status and total.
